metrics.certificate_note: certificate.kind: none, EXPLICITLY. This contract computes no discrete logarithm and collects no relation, so there is no solve or relation claim to certify (docs/claims-and-verification.md). Its forced-value checks -- the liftable-count identity per curve, T_obs = 0 for `order`, p_lower = 1.0 at R5_PERCLASS, the closed-form-versus-Monte-Carlo null mean, the Hurwitz-Kronecker census -- are internal consistency checks, not certificates, and are reported as such.
metrics.supersedes_reason: RUN-INSTR-85b102-gates carries a defective frozen_function_diff artifact: the per-function comparison hashed inspect.getsource output (trailing newline retained) against ast.get_source_segment output (trailing newline absent), so all 11 frozen functions were reported CHANGED_OR_UNRESOLVED on a normalization artifact, and the file-level rows compared against origin/main rather than against the commit the contract was approved at. implementation_error in one required artifact of that run; its S0, S1 and S2 numbers are unaffected and reproduce here identically. Run records are immutable, so the defective run is preserved and superseded, never overwritten.
